/* ---------------- FLOWER HEADINGS ---------------- */

.section-heading {

.section-heading img {

/* no hover anchor links on headings */
.anchorjs-link,

/* ---------------- RESEARCH QUESTION ---------------- */

.research-question {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1.15fr;
  gap: 3.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.question-copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: stretch;
  min-width: 0;
}

/* wrapper is exactly as wide as the heading (flower to flower),
   so the question text centers under the heading */
.question-block {
  width: fit-content;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* heading: title centered, flowers pinned to the left/right edges,
   so the box is perfectly symmetric around the title */
.question-block .section-heading {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  margin-left: 0;
  margin-right: 0;
  padding-left: calc(32px + 0.85rem);
  padding-right: calc(32px + 0.85rem);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.question-block .section-heading span {
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.question-block .section-heading img {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.question-block .section-heading img:first-of-type {
  left: 0;
}

.question-block .section-heading img:last-of-type {
  right: 0;
}

/* hide anything else the theme may inject into the heading */
.question-block .section-heading > :not(img):not(span),
.question-block .section-heading::before,
.question-block .section-heading::after {
  display: none !important;
}

.question-block .question-text {
  width: 0;
  min-width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
}

.question-text {
  font-family: "Fraunces", serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.45vw, 1.28rem);

  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--black);
  margin: 0;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
}

  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.map-panel img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  object-fit: contain;
  border-radius: 20px;
}

/* ---------------- METHODOLOGY ---------------- */

.methodology-section {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto 6rem;
}

.methodology-content {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

}

.methodology-text {

.methodology-image img {

}

/* ---------------- KEY FINDINGS ---------------- */

.key-findings-section {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto 6rem;
}

.findings-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

}

.finding {

}

.key-finding-icon {
  width: 82px;

}

.key-finding-icon svg {
  width: 43px;

}

.key-finding-icon .purple-fill {

}

.key-finding-label {
  font-family: "Fraunces", serif;

  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.2;

}

/* ---------------- PRESENTATION / ACKNOWLEDGMENT ---------------- */

.presentation-row {

  <main class="poster-content">

    <!-- RESEARCH QUESTION -->

    <section class="research-question">

      <div class="question-copy">

        <div class="question-block">

          <h2 class="section-heading centered">
            <img src="../../assets/logo.png" alt="">
            <span>Research Question</span>
            <img src="../../assets/logo.png" alt="">
          </h2>

          <p class="question-text">
            How do social determinants of health shape premature death rates across racial groups in the United States?
          </p>

        </div>

      </div>

      <div class="map-panel">
        <img src="plot1.png" alt="Premature deaths by county in the United States">
      </div>

    </section>


    <!-- METHODOLOGY -->

    <section class="methodology-section">

      <h2 class="section-heading centered">
        <img src="../../assets/logo.png" alt="">
        <span>Methodology</span>
        <img src="../../assets/logo.png" alt="">
      </h2>

      <div class="methodology-content">

        <div class="methodology-text">

          <p>
           The study utilized data from the County Health Rankings data set. Statistical modelings methods were implemented using R   evaluate relationships between mortality and various Social Determinants of Health (SDOH). Based on exploratory data analysis, two distinct modeling approaches were chosen to be compared:
          </p>

          <ul>
Observe direct linear relationships between SDOH variables and the outcome.</li>
            <li><strong>Gradient Boosted Trees:</strong> Capture non-linear relationships between variables.</li>
          </ul>

          <p>

        </div>

        <div class="methodology-image">
          <img src="plot2.png" alt="Relationship between socioeconomic factors and premature deaths">
        </div>

      </div>

    </section>


    <!-- KEY FINDINGS -->

    <section class="key-findings-section">

      <h2 class="section-heading centered">
        <img src="../../assets/logo.png" alt="">
        <span>Key Findings</span>
        <img src="../../assets/logo.png" alt="">
      </h2>

      <div class="findings-grid">

        <!-- FINDING 1 -->

        <div class="finding">

          <div class="key-finding-icon">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true">
              <circle cx="24" cy="29" r="5.5"></circle>
              <circle cx="40" cy="29" r="5.5"></circle>
              <circle cx="32" cy="22" r="6"></circle>
              <path d="M14 49c1.3-8 6.5-12.5 13-12.5"></path>
              <path d="M50 49c-1.3-8-6.5-12.5-13-12.5"></path>
              <path d="M22 51c1-9 6-14.5 10-14.5s9 5.5 10 14.5"></path>
              <path class="purple-fill" d="M32 13s-6.5-3.8-6.5-8.2c0-2.3 1.7-4 4-4 1.3 0 2.5.7 3.2 1.9C33.4 1.5 34.6.8 36 .8c2.3 0 4 1.7 4 4C40 9.2 32 13 32 13z"></path>
            </svg>
          </div>

          <div class="key-finding-text">
            <h3 class="key-finding-label">Socioeconomic Impact</h3>
            <p>
              Higher income inequality and unemployment were linked to more years of premature death (earlier deaths). Higher high school completion rates are linked to fewer years of premature deaths.
            </p>
          </div>

        </div>


        <!-- FINDING 2 -->

        <div class="finding">

          <div class="key-finding-icon">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true">
              <path d="M12 52h40"></path>
              <rect x="16" y="37" width="7" height="15"></rect>
              <rect x="29" y="28" width="7" height="24"></rect>
              <rect x="42" y="18" width="7" height="34"></rect>
              <path class="purple-fill" d="M28 8.5l3 6.1 6.7 1-4.9 4.8 1.2 6.8-6-3.2-6 3.2 1.2-6.8-4.9-4.8 6.7-1 3-6.1z"></path>
            </svg>
          </div>

          <div class="key-finding-text">
            <h3 class="key-finding-label">Variable Importance</h3>
            <p>
              Multiple linear regression identified AIAN population percentage as the most important variable, likely due to the model's sensitivity to this group's small population percentages across the U.S.
            </p>
          </div>

        </div>


        <!-- FINDING 3 -->

        <div class="finding">

          <div class="key-finding-icon">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true">
              <path d="M10 52h44"></path>
              <path d="M14 43l10-11 9 7 16-22"></path>
              <circle cx="14" cy="43" r="3.2" class="purple-fill"></circle>
              <circle cx="24" cy="32" r="3.2" class="purple-fill"></circle>
              <circle cx="33" cy="39" r="3.2" class="purple-fill"></circle>
              <circle cx="49" cy="17" r="3.2" class="purple-fill"></circle>
              <path d="M14 16h14"></path>
              <path d="M14 23h20"></path>
              <path d="M14 9h26"></path>
            </svg>
          </div>

          <div class="key-finding-text">
            <h3 class="key-finding-label">Model Performance</h3>
            <p>
              Cross-validation showed the gradient boosted tree captured relationships in the data that multiple linear regression did not.
            </p>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
